install.title: Install the app
install.body: Add TCG Life & Timers to your home screen for full-screen play that works offline.
install.ios.title: Add to Home Screen
install.ios.step1: Tap the Share button in Safari's toolbar.
install.ios.step2: Scroll down and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
install.ios.step3: Tap “Add”. Open the app from your home screen next time.
